# English word data

Author: Electronic Frontier Foundation (EFF). Original unmodified long wordlist,
published July 2016, retrieved from the official source on 2026-10-07.

- Source: https://www.eff.org/files/2016/07/18/eff_large_wordlist.txt
- Method: https://www.eff.org/deeplinks/2016/07/new-wordlists-random-passphrases
- Copyright policy: https://www.eff.org/copyright
- License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International, per EFF's current
  policy for original EFF material unless otherwise noted.
- License terms: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
- SHA-256: `addd35536511597a02fa0a9ff1e5284677b8883b83e986e43f15a3db996b903e`
- Exact size: 108800 bytes. 7776 unique entries, retained with original dice codes.
- Changes: none. Runtime groups entries by first letter; no themes or invented words.

EFF documents prioritizing English word recognition and concreteness. This is a
curated familiar-word list, not a frequency ranking or proof every person knows
every entry. English is the only supported language. No translation is implied.
Older third-party packages cite CC BY 3.0; this copy uses the current official
source and EFF policy above. No EFF endorsement of AUKORA is implied.

Measured first-letter counts:
`a:407 b:362 c:751 d:547 e:398 f:308 g:304 h:249 i:115 j:96 k:55 l:194 m:295
n:97 o:246 p:578 q:37 r:513 s:1087 t:323 u:476 v:132 w:155 x:2 y:27 z:22`.

Four entries contain hyphens, retained unchanged: drop-down, felt-tip, t-shirt,
yo-yo. All initials are lowercase ASCII. Seven-word acrostic selection restricts
each position to its initial bucket. No entropy, password-strength, recovery
security or biometric claim is made from these counts.
